info.title: Tasker API
info.description: REST API of Tasker. The same API is served by the Tasker server (Server mode, JWT sign-in) and by the local daemon (Local mode, no sign-in, loopback only; every request is addressed to one workspace through the /w/{workspace} prefix). x-tasker-modes on an operation lists where it exists: server, local, daemon (control interface of the daemon, which has its own address and secret). Lists are pages {totalCount, offset, limit, data}. PATCH changes only the fields that are sent (null or absent keep the value) and needs the version the client saw; DELETE takes it in the version query parameter. Errors are {error}; a conflict (409) also carries code: in_use (the entity is used), modified (someone changed it first: reload and retry), locked (someone is editing it, heldBy says who) or unsupported_format.

servers.description: Tasker server (Server mode): sign in with POST /api/auth/login and send the access token as a Bearer token
Tasker daemon (Local mode): no sign-in, loopback only; the workspace is the key of an open folder

get.summary: Live changes of the workspace (Server-Sent Events)
get.description: A stream of text/event-stream, kept open until the client disconnects or the workspace closes. Each event is one line `data: <WorkspaceChange as JSON>` followed by an empty line; there are no named events. Lines starting with a colon are comments to ignore: `: connected` right after the connection opens and `: ping` every 20 seconds while idle. Equal events within 150 ms are merged. Treat an event as a hint to reload what it names (entity, projectId, id); after a reconnect reload everything, events are not replayed.

code.description: in_use: the entity is used elsewhere; modified: someone changed it since the client read it; locked: someone is editing it (heldBy); unsupported_format: the data was written by a newer version of Tasker.

entity.description: What changed: project, task, taskType, linkType, field, enum, status, statusSet, board, series, user; lock (a lock on the entity with this id was taken or released; the kind is not given); unknown (something changed: reload everything).

bearerAuth.description: Server mode: the access token from POST /api/auth/login, /api/auth/register or /api/auth/refresh.
